Subject: Post-call: HortonTech private deployment — architecture review scheduling

Hi Tom — great to meet today, and thanks for the thoughtful questions. Quick recap from our discovery + suggested next steps so we can get a focused architecture review scheduled: 

Recap (short):
- Goal: pilot Redwood Private behind HortonTech VPC for latency-sensitive customer support assistant (P95 latency target ~120ms).
- Expected steady throughput: ~40 concurrent sessions, peak bursts to ~150 qps; model candidate: 7B quantized (team open to 13B if latency permits).
- Data residency: primary in us-west-2; audit logs retained 90 days.
- Decision stakeholders: you (CTO), Anika (Network), Raj (Cloud Security), procurement (next month).

Ask / next step:
- We recommend a 60–90 minute architecture review (technical deep dive) with Network + Security + Infra + Redwood Solutions/Infra engineers.
- Proposed times (PST):
  • Tue Mar 23, 10:00–11:30 AM PST
  • Thu Mar 25, 1:00–2:30 PM PST
If neither works, send two slots that suit Anika/Raj and we’ll accommodate.

What we'll bring:
- Private deployment architecture checklist (attached) and a short runbook for VPC peering, egress controls, and key management.
- Sample Terraform snippets and sizing guidance for expected throughput.

Attachments: discovery-notes-20270318.pdf (notes from today)

Thanks — if you can confirm attendees and preferred slot, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
